args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the base URL for the password reset email link to be configurable from the environment variable PUBLIC_URL. Currently it defaults to "http://localhost:3000" which causes the email links to point to localhost in production or staging environments. This fix ensures that the reset password link uses the proper base URL for the deployment environment.
